build_lambda_returns: build multistep lambda returns from reward, discount, and value sequences for TD(λ), Q(λ), or Sarsa(λ) updates
compute_n_step_bootstrapped_returns: compute strided n-step bootstrapped return targets over a trajectory with configurable lambda mixing
calculate_discounted_returns: calculate discounted returns from a trajectory by combining rewards and discounts with bootstrapped values
compute_truncated_gae: compute truncated generalized advantage estimates for policy optimization using advantage decomposition
calculate_off_policy_returns: calculate off-policy generalized returns supporting importance sampling, tree-backup, and retrace corrections
